name: mc_walk
title: Walk reachability
description:
Checks where a player can walk inside a box under real movement rules, and names the blocking cell and reason when they cannot. Read-only.

WHEN TO USE: "can a player walk from A to B?" (mode path: move count and waypoints) or "can every door, bed or staircase be reached from the entrance?" (mode reach with targets), after building stairs, decks, corridors, ledges or paths over snow. Failures give the nearest reachable place and why the next move fails: step too high (with the rise), headroom (the block overhead), closed door, stair approached from the side or back, gap, water, hazard or the box edge.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for line of sight (mc_sightline) or block lists (mc_inspect). It does not simulate entities, sprint jumps, ice, slime, elytra or boats; doors keep their current state unless rules.doors is "any".

PARAMETERS: from/to are FEET positions (the air cell the player stands in); a place matches when the feet are within half a block of y, so a slab or snow floor at y-1 still counts. box {from,to} must contain from, to and targets and reach at least 2 blocks above the highest floor (cells above count as air; columns outside are never entered); at most 4 x limits.max-read-volume. For a long or diagonal trail give waypoints instead of box: each leg gets its own box within that limit. Collision heights: snow (layers-1)/8, carpet 1/16, bottom slab 0.5, bed 9/16, fences, walls and closed gates 1.5; a bottom stair is a 0.5 step only when walked onto toward its facing. Moves are the four horizontal directions. targets "doors" checks each lower door half (reachable when both sides are), "beds" standing on or beside it, "stairs" standing on each bottom stair.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only; the box is read like mc_inspect (it can load chunks) and searched off the main thread.

from.description: Start feet position [x, y, z]: the cell the player's feet are in.

to.description: Destination feet position [x, y, z] (path mode).

box.description: Inclusive area searched; include 2+ blocks above the highest floor.

world.description: World name; default: the configured default world.

mode.description: path (route from -> to) or reach (everything reachable from from). Default: path when to is given, else reach.

jump.description: Allow jumping up to 1.25. Default false.

stepHeight.description: Largest rise walked without jumping (slabs, carpet, snow, head-on stairs). Default 0.6.

maxDrop.description: Largest drop allowed (fall damage starts above 3). Default 3.

allowLadders.description: Ladders, vines and scaffolding are climbable. Default true.

doors.description: open-only (default): closed doors and gates block; any: all pass.

targets.description: Reach mode: "doors", "beds", "stairs", or a list of up to 256 feet positions [x, y, z].

waypoints.description: Route mode, instead of box/to/mode/targets/samples: feet positions visited in order after from (the last is the destination), up to 32. Each leg is searched in its own box around its two ends (margin sideways, 4 below, 4 above); the reply gives one line per leg and stops at the first leg that is not walkable.

margin.description: Route mode: blocks added sideways around each leg, 1-32. Default 6; raise it when a leg needs a detour.

samples.description: Most waypoints / unreachable targets listed, 1-200. Default 50.
